title: Modules may import only the public ``terp.core`` surface, never ``_internal``
intent: Modules may import only the public ``terp.core`` surface, never ``_internal``

runtime.rationale: Python has no enforced import visibility: at runtime _internal objects are ordinary attributes, reachable through the public modules that legitimately use them. The underscore contract is source-form; the runtime controls live in what _internal implements, not in refusing its import.
